name: browser-use
headline: SEO-GEO Blog Writer - Optimize Blog Posts
short_description: Creates blog posts optimized for search engines and AI citations. Content teams use it to improve visibility and reach. Integrates with CMS platforms and analytics tools.
author: weipanux

sections.overview:
SEO-GEO Blog Writer creates high-performing blog content optimized for both traditional search engines and generative AI citations. The skill operates in two modes: Mode A for keyword-driven content when you know your target keyword, and Mode B for topic-based content that includes automated keyword research and selection. It executes a four-phase workflow—research, outline, draft, and optimize—that incorporates E-E-A-T principles, generates schema markup, and performs automated validation with 80+ score targets. Content teams use this skill to improve visibility across Google search results and AI chatbot citations, reducing manual content planning and optimization work.
E-commerce tutorials targeting specific long-tail keywords like 'how to start a Shopify store'
Mental health and wellness content optimized for AI citation formats
Technical tutorials and guides that rank in Google and appear in AI-generated responses
Product comparison posts using automated keyword research to find high-intent topics
sections.setup:
No install command available. Check the GitHub repository for manual installation instructions.
`git clone https://github.com/weipanux/seo-geo-blog-writer`
sections.usage:
```
Write a 1000-word blog post for [COMPANY] in the [INDUSTRY] industry. The post should be optimized for SEO with the target keyword '[KEYWORD]' and include geo-specific references to [LOCATION]. Ensure the content is engaging, informative, and ready for publication. Include a meta description and suggested tags.
```
Copy

```
# The Ultimate Guide to Sustainable Packaging for E-Commerce Businesses in California
```
